notes.title: Husk update #5 - The next step for Husk | Now 40% off!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Community,[/b]
 
in the recent days, we’ve been a little bit quiet, but it doesn’t mean that we don’t have quite a few surprises for you, the horror fans!

[h1]Patch[/h1]
For the last weeks, we have been fixing the game in a team of just three people, working around the clock, during our spare time. We wanted to do everything we could to polish the game further. You provided us with unparalleled support from the beginning, and we would like to thank you deeply from our hearts.

We’ve managed to deliver a number of fixes. Hopefully, they are going to make a difference for you - check them out!
[list]
[*]Area after the boss fight, where player has to cross the river, should now always load properly
[*]Falling rocks will no longer push player off a cliff
[*]In the diner, player will no longer be pushed into a corner by an opening door
[*]Various textures improvements
[*]Various sound improvements
[*]Added [b]FoV slider[/b] to game options (range 90 - 120)
[/list]
[h1]Sale![/h1]
We’ve also launched a special sale this week. From 10th to 17th of April, you can grab [b]Husk[/b] with a huge [b]40% discount![/b] It’s the first promo ever, so if you had [b]Husk[/b] on your [b]Steam wishlist[/b], it’s a perfect time to challenge yourself in [b]Shivercliff[/b] - a city full of dark mysteries.

We wish you [b]happy Easter[/b] and keep in mind that we will never forget about all the support you gave us! You are amazing, community members!

[b]All the best,[/b]
[i]The Undead Scout Team[/i]

notes.title: Husk Update #4 - Achievements are here!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Horror Lovers[/b],

It is time for our fourth update which brings some goodies - you will like this one! So, without further ado, here are the improvements:
[list]
[*]Achievements are here - see what's unlocked and what you need to complete!
[*]Melee combat changes - blows now stun monsters and every new stun lasts shorter, monsters have cooldown between attacks,
[*]Added new attack animations, player's death and damage animations,
[*]Various sound fixes,
[*]Level streaming fixes.
[/list]
Of course, this is not the end. We continue working on [b]Husk[/b] as hard as ever. We're currently waiting for [b]Steam's[/b] approval for the game's trading cards - they should be here soon. As an addition, we want you to have these beautiful, hi-res [b]Husk[/b] wallpapers, which can be downloaded [url=welcometoshivercliff.com/media]here[/url].

[b]Thanks for staying with us[/b],
[i]The UndeadScout Team[/i]

notes.title: The second update is live now!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players[/b],

We continue our hard work on improving [b]Husk[/b]. Now it's time for another update that will make our game a better experience. Expect a few more updates in the near future as we continue polishing the game. In the meantime check the list for the full details about this one:

Features:
[list]
[*]added new types of scripts in [b]Act V[/b],
[*]added an [b]invert option[/b] to the game menu.[/list]
Optimization:
[list]
[*][b]direction-light shadows[/b] are now disabled when using medium graphic settings,
[*]dynamic [b]Depth of Field[/b] is now disabled when using medium graphic settings (or lower).[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*]fixed problems with collisions in [b]Act VII[/b],
[*]fixed main data streaming issues,
[*]the elevator in [b]Act II[/b] should work properly now,
[*]various small fixes, including no sound while equipping an item, sound issues, scripts repetition, etc.[/list]
Please let us know about your opinion about these fixes and enhancements, as well as about things we need to polish further. A short break is now over and it’s time for us to work on the next update.

[b]Thanks for all support you show to us![/b]
[i]The UndeadScout Team[/i]

notes.title: The first update is LIVE
notes.content:
Dear players,

As promised, we are starting a series of updates that are going to make Husk a better and fuller experience for you. After having spent [b]over 13 hours[/b] straight in our 3-men team today, we managed to roll out the first set of fixes for you. That's the list:
[list]
[*] using melee weapon now damages enemies instead of stunning them,
[*] you can't leave the police station without acquiring the gun anymore,
[*] workaround: added the gun pickup before the gate in the forest for those of you who missed the gun at the police station - that means you don't need to go back anymore, simply move forward and you should find the gun inon a stone in the forest in front of the gate,
[*] removed firing spread/offset when stamina level is low,
[*] the first enemy type has now less health points,
[*] various sound fixes,
[*] various model improvements,
[*] various texture fixes,
[*] fixes for some moments when levels were not being loaded correctly.
[/list]
Please let us know how you are finding this update - for us, it's time to drink some coffee/energy drinks and [b]start working on the next one[/b]! 

[b]Thanks again for your support[/b],
[i]Łukasz, Paweł and Miłosz from UndeadScout[/i]

notes.title: Post-release thoughts and a roadmap for the next weeks
notes.content:
Dear community,

It has not been easy 2 days for us with so much publicity around Husk and so much feedback that we already got from the community to process and make use of. We are also perfectly aware of issues related to the game (both technical and gameplaywise) - the good news is that thanks to our partners at IMGN.PRO we are able to [b]focus solely on improving Husk and making it a better experience for every single one of you[/b]. 

We created two subforums on Steam where you can leave your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/553960/discussions/4/]bug reports[/url] as well as [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/553960/discussions/2/]ideas/suggestions for future updates[/url]. You can also write to us at support@undeadscout.com if you spotted a bug or have an idea on what to change in Husk. We are monitoring these and other channels very closely and hopefully you are going to see the results of these efforts in the upcoming weeks.

[h1]What can you expect in the near future specifically?[/h1]
[list]
[*] adding new layers of audio,
[*] fixing wrong or improper sounds,
[*] fixing gamepad interactions,
[*] fixing how tutorials are displayed,
[*] adding new tutorials,
[*] adding first modifications to the combat system,
[*] improved optimization so that the game runs better on your PCs.
[/list]

We would love to release the first update in the first half of the next week, followed by a second update within the time of 2 weeks. If we encounter any unexpected difficulties, change our priorities based on your feedback or if it turns out we can’t implement a particular fix within a reasonable timespan, we are going to immediately let you know. [b]Please stay with us - this is definitely not the end of our work on Husk.[/b]

Thanks for your support,
[i]The UndeadScout Team[/i]
